_source: Official Rockwell Automation Publication 1769-TD008C-EN-P, p. 6, Technical Specifications - 1769 Compact I/O Power Supplies. The fourth header is `1769-PB4, 1769-PB4K`; its values are Input voltage range 19.2...31.2 V DC, Input voltage nom 24 V DC, Current capacity @ 5V 4.0 A and Current capacity @ 24V 1.7 A.
_notes: PB4K shares the same printed column and is not a conflicting sibling for these values. PA2/PA4/PB2 values are other columns and must not be emitted for PB4.
